description: This file defines a CLI command class 'InstallerCountryListCommand' for the OrangeHRM system, responsible for listing country options and handling country selection input.

classes.name: InstallerCountryListCommand
classes.description: A command class for listing and optionally filtering by country within the installer module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CLI command, 'install:country-list'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command options, adding a 'country' option.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command: lists countries, optionally filters by country if the option is provided, and handles invalid input.
